reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E3) describes dual-phase microstructures, oxide film formation, and improved wear/corrosion resistance in various HEAs, but none provides specific support for the key premises of localized galvanic coupling, nonuniform oxide formation due to phase differences, or synergistic degradation under simultaneous wear and corrosion. The evidence is only loosely related to the mechanistic claims.
premises: Multiphase eutectic HEAs contain distinct phases with different oxidation and electrochemical properties
These phase differences generate localized micro-galvanic cells
Micro-galvanic couples cause nonuniform oxide film formation
Mechanical wear continuously ruptures the oxide film
Film rupture and reformation synergistically accelerate both wear and corrosion
